title: docs(schema-reference): dashboard widgets teach layout and type + options, not colSpan / rowSpan / body
body:
Fixes #8290
Clause-②: no — documentation only: it stops a published page from teaching keys (`colSpan`, `rowSpan`, `body`) that the strict `DashboardWidgetSchema` refuses by name. No schema, export or accept set moves.

## What changed

`content/docs/api/schema-reference.md`, the `DashboardComponentSchema` section only (JSON example, `widgets` row, prose under the table), plus one empty-frontmatter changeset.

- **Example.** Each widget sizes itself with `layout: { x, y, w, h }` instead of `colSpan` / `rowSpan`, and holds its content as a family in `type` with settings under `options` (`metric`, `list`), or as a registered component node in `component` (the `chart` widget) instead of `body`.
- **`widgets` row.** The type column names both arms of the slot as landed by objectui#7952 (component arm first, as on both faces): `(DashboardWidgetSlotComponentSchema | DashboardWidgetSchema)[]`. The description names `layout`, `type` + `options`, `component`, and the component-node arm.
- **Prose.** Says what `layout` is (all four numbers or none), that `colSpan` / `rowSpan` / `body` are refused by name (objectui#6002), what each family reads from `options`, and that a `metric` widget's caption is `options.description`.

The seconds half of the card was already discharged at base `cc4366d`: the row reads `refreshIntervalSeconds` ("Auto-refresh interval in **seconds**", objectui#7783), the example writes `"refreshIntervalSeconds": 30`, and both renderers compute `schema.refreshIntervalSeconds * 1000` (`DashboardRenderer`, `DashboardGridLayout`). Not redone.

## Parse evidence (scratch harness, source zod faces, not committed)

The harness takes the first `json` fence under `### DashboardComponentSchema` in the file it is given and parses it.

Control, base `cc4366d` copy of the page:

```text
DashboardComponentSchema.safeParse(example) success=false
  node issue code=invalid_union path=["widgets",0]  msg=Invalid input
  node issue code=invalid_union path=["widgets",1]  msg=Invalid input
  node issue code=invalid_union path=["widgets",2]  msg=Invalid input
  widget id=revenue DashboardWidgetSchema success=false unrecognized_keys keys=["colSpan","rowSpan","body"] path=[]
  widget id=chart DashboardWidgetSchema success=false unrecognized_keys keys=["colSpan","rowSpan","body"] path=[]
  widget id=tasks DashboardWidgetSchema success=false unrecognized_keys keys=["colSpan","rowSpan","body"] path=[]
```

This branch, head `5eca3f2`:

```text
DashboardComponentSchema.safeParse(example) success=true
  widget id=revenue DashboardWidgetSchema success=true
  widget id=chart DashboardWidgetSchema success=true
  widget id=tasks DashboardWidgetSchema success=true
chart widget component -> ChartSchema.safeParse success=true keys=["type","data","chartType","series","xAxisKey"]
```

Prose probes: `area` / `bar` / `line` / `pie` / `metric` / `list` / `table` / `metric-card` are all members of `DashboardWidgetTypeSchema`, and a widget with `layout: { w: 2, h: 1 }` is refused `invalid_type` at `layout.x` and `layout.y`.

TypeScript face: I pasted the example into a scratch file as `const doc: DashboardComponentSchema = …` (imported from `packages/types/src/complex`) and ran `tsc --strict`. The new example produces 0 diagnostics in that file. The base example produces 3 (TS2322, one per `body`). Both runs also show the same 2 environment-only diagnostics in `complex.ts`, "Cannot find namespace 'React'", which come from `--ignoreConfig`.

## Deviation: the chart widget uses the `component` slot

My first commit (`13b194c`) wrote the chart as `"type": "area"` + `options`. `check:doc-types` rejected it: `unregistered-doc-type ... type 'area' (json)`. No spec chart family is a registered component key. A shorthand chart family inside a docs code block therefore needs a `DOC_TYPE_EXEMPTIONS` entry in `scripts/check-doc-component-types.mjs`, which is outside this claim's file surface. The chart widget now puts its `chart` node in `component`. That form is legal on this node and needs no exemption. It also means the example shows both content forms the row names. The prose teaches the chart families' `options` keys. If the seat prefers the shorthand chart in the example, the follow-up is one exemption entry of the same kind the `guide/dashboard-filters.md` `bar` / `line` entries already are.
